pages.title: Banteng
pages.text: The banteng ($(o)Bos javanicus$()) is a species of wild cattle native to Southeast Asia, including mainland forests, Java and Borneo.$(br2)Both sexes have white lower legs and a white patch on the rump. Bulls are dark brown to black, while cows and calves are a reddish brown.$(br2)Banteng have been domesticated as Bali cattle, which are raised widely across Indonesia.
